lessons.title: What Is a Community?
lessons.description: Learn that a community is a place where people live, work, and play together.

lessons.title: Community Helpers
lessons.description: Meet firefighters, doctors, teachers, and other helpers.

lessons.title: Rules and Laws
lessons.description: Understand why communities need rules to stay safe.

lessons.title: Urban, Suburban, and Rural
lessons.description: Compare life in a city, suburb, and the countryside.

lessons.title: What Is a Map?
lessons.description: Learn that maps show us places from above.

lessons.title: Map Symbols and Keys
lessons.description: Read a map legend to understand what the symbols mean.

lessons.title: Continents and Oceans
lessons.description: Name the 7 continents and 5 oceans of the world.

lessons.title: Cardinal Directions
lessons.description: Learn north, south, east, and west with a compass rose.

lessons.title: The First Americans
lessons.description: Learn about Native American peoples and their way of life.

lessons.title: Explorers
lessons.description: Discover the explorers who traveled to the Americas.

lessons.title: The 13 Colonies
lessons.description: Learn how the first 13 colonies were formed.

lessons.title: The American Revolution
lessons.description: Find out how America became its own country.

lessons.title: What Is Government?
lessons.description: Learn why we need leaders to make decisions for everyone.

lessons.title: The President
lessons.description: Find out what the President does and where they live.

lessons.title: Making Laws
lessons.description: See how an idea becomes a law that everyone follows.

lessons.title: Voting
lessons.description: Understand how people choose their leaders by voting.
